To modify the CMPGetResults formula to write the results to the range AB26:NW35, you can change the "row_offset" and "col_start" parameters. Here's the updated formula:

=CMPGetResults(IF(AC6="Base",Z6,Z7),AE6&"_values","varray",TRUE,"row_offset",20,"col_offset",-1,"col_start",AJ6,"col_limit",AK6)

The changes are:

1. "row_offset" is changed from 2 to 20, to start the results from row 26 (26 = 20 + 6, where 6 is the starting row).
2. "col_start" remains the same, using the value from cell AJ6, which determines the starting column.

With these changes, the results will be written to the range AB26:NW35.
